description: Estimate the total cost of buying an item in Japan and having it forwarded abroad. Example: {price_jpy: 4500, sku_id: "ichiban-kuji-kh-2018-a", dest_country: "US"}. Returns routes[] (forwarding service × shipping method, with fees and total_jpy, cheapest first) and cheapest. Figures are estimates from published fee tables, not quotes; we are not affiliated with any forwarding service.

dest_country.description: Destination country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "US", "GB", "AU".

proxy.description: Only show one forwarding service, e.g. "buyee". Optional.

sku_id.description: Catalog sku_id, used to look up the weight. Optional.

weight_g.description: Package weight in grams, when there is no sku_id or the catalog has no weight.

name: estimate_landed_cost
title: Estimate landed cost
